operator-walkthrough.deferred: WHAT THE OPERATOR SEES after this diff (2026-10-25, branch nickstire/admin-pipeline-live): Admin -> Sales Pipeline opens on 'Today's follow-ups': a header '<n> due now · <N> open', the five opportunities due now (each card: what to do and the age, e.g. 'Call back <phone>: used tires 225/55R17, 21 h ago', then why, then 'Receptionist: <summary excerpt>' and 'Service: <mention>' when the row carries them, then the phone), Called / Texted / Not relevant as before, and a 44 px 'Show all <N>' that opens the rest; a failed read says 'Follow-ups couldn't load: UNKNOWN, not clear' with Retry; an empty list says nothing is due. The feed itself changed on the server: a VAPI call becomes a card only when the receptionist's daily evaluation says the need is unresolved (callback needed, a tire-availability or quote question left open, a lost opportunity); an answered hours or price question, a walk-in directed, a handoff, spam, an abandoned or failed call, or a call not yet evaluated is never a card, so the 169 'Missed call: 23s call 1295min ago' cards of 2026-10-25 do not recur, and the old ones are retired as superseded (dismissed, never lost) by the reconciler's next pass. The Leads tab is one list with three chips (Needs response, Waiting, Closed): first name, source badge, the request's first line, received and last-touch ages, tap to call, Mark contacted or Lost, Change status, delivery log; the kanban, the stat cards and the unsourced banner are gone. The Hiring tab holds the job applicants panel alone, out of the sales lane. Old links ?leadsTab=pipeline and ?leadsTab=opportunities and the retired ?tab=opportunities land on the right tabs; the command palette shortcuts follow. Not walked through live before this push (the production admin's sign-in is the owner's Google account; the local dev MySQL truncates its schema); the live read happens in the owner's Chrome after deploy and goes in docs/agent-os/ledger/2026-10-25-admin-tabs-pipeline.md.
